steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s=window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: assert-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.styleTransfer !== false) throw new Error('styleTransfer must be OFF in Simple mode')

steps.name: assert-shown-in-pro
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.styleTransfer) throw new Error('styleTransfer must be ON in Pro mode')

steps.name: apply-first
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#style-transfer button')).find(x => (x.textContent||'').trim() === 'Apply'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Apply button'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: style-applied
steps.failMessage: master palette did not update after applying a style

steps.name: assert-finish-changed
steps.eval: (() => { const f = window.__store.getState().finishes.floor.livingDining; if (!f || !String(f).startsWith('floor-')) throw new Error('floor finish not applied: ' + f); if (f === window.__origFloor) throw new Error('floor finish did not change from original'); })()

steps.name: undo-toast
steps.failMessage: Undo action button not shown on the applied toast

steps.name: click-undo
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toast-host .toast-act')).find(x => /Undo/.test(x.textContent||'')); if (!b) throw new Error('no Undo button'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: reverted
steps.failMessage: Undo did not revert the floor finish to its original value
